item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 31/Jul/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will bring a few showers to the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will become fine and persistently very hot over southeastern China in the following few days, but there will still be one or two showers.

Date/Month: 01/08 (Thursday)
Wind: South to southwest force 3 to 4, occasionally force 5 offshore at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. More showers with a few thunderstorms in the morning. Hot with sunny periods during the day.
Temp range: 27 - 32 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium

Date/Month: 02/08 (Friday)
